name: Ane ☆ Suku ~Wagamama! Ane to Sukumizu Yuuwaku Tokkun~
original_name: 姉☆スク～わがまま！姉とスク水誘惑特訓～
source:
Mitsuyoshi has an older sister, Kotomi, who is always bossy to him. But she is special.... One day, he drowns in pool, and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, she is looking down his face worriedly. He is saved thanks to her artificial respiratory.... Since then, their relationship becomes closer and...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106091212/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1007145]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
光义有一个总是对他颐指气使的姐姐琴美。但她很特别……一天，他在泳池中溺水，失去了意识。醒来时，她正焦急地俯视着他的脸。多亏了她的人工呼吸，他得救了……从那以后，两人的关系变得更加亲近了……
